title: Courts (Civil and Criminal Justice) Reform Act 2021 (Act 25 of 2021); section 212 amends the Telecommunications Act
kind: the text of the Act or notification, from the e-Gazette copy
header_as_printed: Courts (Civil and Criminal Justice) / Reform Bill / REPUBLIC OF SINGAPORE / Bill No. /2021. / GOVERNMENT GAZETTE / Read the first time on / 2021. / ACTS SUPPLEMENT / Published by Authority / NO. 24] FRIDAY, OCTOBER 15 [2021 / First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 11 October 2021 at 5 pm. / The following Act was passed by Parliament on 14 September 2021 and / assented to by the President on 28 September 2021:— / REPUBLIC OF SINGAPORE
first_published_line_as_printed: First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 11 October 2021 at 5 pm.
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
obtained_how: One GET request (python urllib, scratchpad tools/gazette-fetch5.py), User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", five seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository, at the exact URL the team lead gave from the e-Gazette browse page. The assets host answered 200 with Content-Type application/pdf. No search path was used. The text is the output of "pdftotext -layout" on a PDF with a text layer (no OCR), unedited.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/, clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; the wording is quoted in the licence note.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents." This item was published before that date, so this copy is an aid and is not stated to be prima facie evidence.
